messages:
Mira: Starting the preemptible gameday run — kickoff 14:00 PT. Focus: mixed-capacity failover + KV cache warmup behavior. We will evict 20% of spot GPUs in us-west1 in 5m intervals, staging only.
Dan: I'll trigger the eviction script and watch the autoscaler + pod churn. Will post command when I run it.
Jess: Please limit to non-prod namespaces (staging/*). Also confirm telemetry flag set: preempt_test=true so dashboards filter correctly.
Ravi: Suggest disabling autoscale burst temporarily so we can observe reserved-pool fallback instead of huge spin-ups. Otherwise signals get noisy.
Mira: Agreed. Plan: 1) label nodes: `kubectl label nodes --selector=pool=spot preempt-test=enabled` 2) run EvictBot for 20% batches 3) observe p50/p95/p99 and error-rate.
Mira: Config snippet for reference:
```
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  annotations:
    infra.redwood/preempt-test: "true"
```
EvictBot: Scheduled eviction job created by Mira. Details: target=us-west1, pct=20, duration=300s. Command: `evictbot trigger --target=us-west1 --pct=20 --duration=300 --namespace=staging`
Dan: Running now: `evictbot trigger --target=us-west1 --pct=20 --duration=300 --namespace=staging --dry-run=false`
Luke: Early telemetry: KV cache hit_rate 0.62 -> 0.15 within first 90s after eviction, cold-starts visible. p99 generation latency increased from 220ms -> 480ms for affected routes.
Dan: Fallback behavior observed: traffic routed to reserved pool, session affinity preserved for ~85% of requests. Error spike minimal: 0.03% 5xxs during transition window. Token cost uptick ~8% due to regen.
Jess: Quick success checklist (prelim): 1) Error rate <0.1% ✅ 2) Rollback triggers fired on one misconfigured deployment within 40s ✅ 3) Fallback preserved majority of sessions (~85%) — marginal fail 4) Obs: cold-start latency regression — action required.
Mira: Good. Action items: add pre-warm /prefetch jobs for critical routes in staging, increase min-replicas for allocation-sensitive models. @Ravi take owner.
Ravi: I'll implement a canary warm-start job and file INF-6723 for production tuning. Est ETA: EOD tomorrow.
Luke: Also spotted spike in egress bytes during container pulls when reserved nodes scaled: `network.egress_rate ~ 120MB/s -> 420MB/s` — recommend tuning imagePullConcurrency and pre-pulling common images on reserved nodes.
Dan: Uploading raw logs and dashboards to s3: s3://redwood-infra/gameday/1849504321/ — includes perf traces, autoscaler events, EvictBot logs.
Mira: Nice run. Retro at 16:00 to decide next steps. Next run suggestion: increase to 40% and include cross-region failover to validate routing policy. :thumbsup:
